exposure: dilation and curettage (D&C) after uterine artery embolization (UAE)
outcome: decrease in β-hCG level in serum
cohort: 80 childbearing cesarean scar pregnancy (CSP) patients with a cesarean section history, gestational age less than 10 weeks (34 in D&C group, 46 in H/S group)
finding: There is no significant difference in clinical efficacy and safety between UAE + D&C and UAE + H/S for CSP treatment, except for a longer CSP mass disappearance time and increased anesthesia-related side effects in the UAE + H/S group.
